title: Tötungsdelikt zum Nachteil der 13-jährigen Lisa T. – Polizei sucht Zeuginnen und Zeugen zu einem Fahrzeug

extraction.summaryEn: A 13-year-old girl who disappeared on her way to school in Berlin-Marzahn on 3 November 2026 was found dead on 8 November 2026 in a vacant building in Altglietzen, Brandenburg. Police are seeking witnesses regarding a silver Citroën C5 estate suspected to have been used in the offence.
